caseNameFull: G. D. Searle & Co. v. Simon

opinions.text:
C. A. 8th Cir. Motions of Defense Research Institute and Trial Lawyers Association, Chamber of Commerce of the United States, Pharmaceutical Manufacturers Association, American Corporate Counsel Association, and American Insurance Association for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Justice Blackmun and Justice O’Connor would grant certiorari.
